_comment: Model catalog of the app, best to worst per kind. Measured on a Pixel 7 with tools/bench: quality (Whisper: % of words wrong; translator: chrF), time (% of the speaking time), ram (MB), and from those the precision/speed dots 1..5. hidden: another model is better and faster (or it is unusable); listed only when downloaded. general: a general chat model (plain instruction prompt) instead of TranslateGemma's prompt format. The app ships this file and also fetches the latest version from GitHub.

note.en: Faster than turbo, almost as precise.
note.es: Más rápido que turbo y casi igual de preciso.
note.de: Schneller als Turbo, fast genauso genau.
note.fr: Plus rapide que turbo, presque aussi précis.
